title: save_intake_draft input
description: Starts or edits an intake request: a new idea, or an application already built that needs registering. The row is always Draft. The requester is always the caller. Only the requester may edit, and only while it is draft. An AI client can never set the status. The business owner is named by the person's object ID, from find_people.

intakeRequestId.description: Edit this existing draft. Leave out to start a new one.

title.description: A short name for the request.

need.description: The business need in plain words.

proposedKindKey.description: The application kind the requester expects.

businessApplicationId.description: The application this request is about, when it already exists. Only an application the requester holds an owner role on, or a draft application the requester created; otherwise not_authorized.

portfolioId.description: The portfolio the request belongs to. The application an accepted request creates starts in it.

usesAi.description: The requester's statement that it will use AI.

horizonKey.description: Now, next or later, from the horizon value list.

businessOwnerObjectId.description: The person the requester names as the business owner: the object ID find_people gives. A person the product knows, signed in as a user, not leaving, and not the requester. Counts for the Accept gate, is asked by name on the priority decision, and becomes the business owner of the application the accepted intake creates (or the draft it registers) when it has none.

examples.title: Field visit planner
examples.need: Field staff plan site visits in a spreadsheet. We want an app.
